questions.details: Cloud appearing to block Sephiroth's blade before the scene resolves into her death, the funeral at the pool, and Cloud seeing Aerith afterwards while Tifa does not all rest on the transcript's stage directions, not dialogue.

questions.summary: Aerith's funeral in the original (opening of disc 2)
questions.details: Laid to rest in the water in the cinematic that opens disc 2. Located through a walkthrough's screenshot caption only.

questions.summary: Zack's survival at the end of Remake
questions.details: Zack surviving the fight outside Midgar and carrying Cloud. The dialogue supports it; the visuals haven't been checked.

questions.summary: Zack's last stand, the branch point of the world where he survives
questions.details: The original shows his death only visually, in an optional flashback that becomes available after "Inside Cloud's Mind"; the transcript has no dialogue that states it. Needs footage before it can be added as an event and set as the world's branch point.

questions.summary: Which Rebirth chapters retell each arc
questions.details: The arcs list Remake's chapters for the Midgar arc only. Rebirth's chapter-to-arc mapping needs a chapter-by-chapter check; the wiki transcript is incomplete for chapters 8 and 9.

questions.summary: Rebirth's main-world view of the plate fall and Midgar
questions.details: Only the interlude in the world where Zack survives is recorded so far.

questions.summary: Where disc 2 ends in the original
questions.details: Placed after the Highwind scenes (the Highwind segment on disc 2), per a walkthrough. Confirm in the game.
Sources disagree on small words (for example "Deeper into Darkness" against "Deeper Into Darkness"). Use the in-game spelling once checked.
The eras are display ranges for the timeline; revisit them as dated events are added.

interpretations.notes: Rebirth shows two outcomes at the altar and then shows Cloud perceiving Aerith when others don't; it doesn't say which perception is real. Visual details here come from transcript stage directions and still need checking against footage.
interpretations.label: At the altar, Cloud appears to block Sephiroth's blade, before the scene resolves into Sephiroth killing Aerith. After she is laid to rest in the pool, Cloud goes on seeing and speaking with her; Tifa does not see her.

sources.title: rebirth
sources.scene: the altar, the funeral at the pool, the departure

interpretations.notes: Remake doesn't name it here; identified as Nibelheim because it is Cloud's hometown in the original and in Rebirth.
interpretations.label: Only alluded to, as Cloud's burning hometown.

interpretations.notes: Remake doesn't name the town here. It is identified as Nibelheim and this event from the original and Rebirth, where Cloud's hometown is Nibelheim and it burns five years earlier.
interpretations.label: Only alluded to: when Sephiroth appears to Cloud in the wreckage of Sector 8, Cloud insists he killed him, and Sephiroth speaks of Cloud's hometown burning.

interpretations.notes: Which of Rebirth's two outcomes is real is left open.
interpretations.label: In OG, Sephiroth's strike is shown once; in Rebirth, Cloud first appears to deflect it before the scene shows Sephiroth killing Aerith.

interpretations.notes: Rebirth doesn't explain what Cloud is seeing.
interpretations.label: In OG, Cloud mourns that Aerith will no longer talk or laugh; in Rebirth, Cloud goes on seeing and hearing her after her funeral, while Tifa does not.

interpretations.notes: Present in his own account, which Tifa privately doubts; Rebirth doesn't resolve it.
